subject: Civic Education
competence: Explains the need of getting the training related to one’s field of work as a worker.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the need of getting the training related to one’s field of work as a worker.
Expresses views about the available opportunities for vocational training.
Explains the fact that the productivity of labour depends on the training.
the_entrance: The importance of trained labour in the modern world

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of trained labour and its significance
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Take notes on the importance of trained labour

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on vocational training
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and share views
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on the importance of training
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present group findings and compare notes

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Consolidate learning and conduct formative evaluation
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles
